select fished_date_season as season,
  case when fished_date_doy<91 then 'pre-May(<91)'
       when fished_date_doy<121 then 'May(91-120)'
       when fished_date_doy<152 then 'Jun(121-151)'
       else '152+' end as bucket,
  cls,
  count(*) as n_boat_days,
  sum(anglers) as anglers,
  sum(yt) as yt,
  sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0) as yt_per_angler
from trips
where fished_date_season=2
group by 1,2,3
order by 2,3

select index_id, avail_doy, value
from climate
where index_id in ('oni','pdo') and avail_season=2
order by index_id, avail_doy desc
limit 10

select cls, boat, fished_date_doy, anglers, yt
from trips
where fished_date_season=2 and cls in ('day_1_5','three_quarter') and fished_date_doy between 91 and 121 and yt>0
order by cls, fished_date_doy

select cls, boat, count(*) n, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0) ypa
from trips
where fished_date_season=2 and cls='three_quarter' and fished_date_doy between 91 and 121
group by 1,2 order by yt desc

select fished_date_doy, cls, boat, count(*) n, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt
from trips
where fished_date_season=2 and cls in ('overnight','full_day') and fished_date_doy between 91 and 121
group by 1,2,3 having sum(yt)>0
order by fished_date_doy

select avail_doy as doy, avg(wtmp_c) avg_c
from pier
where avail_season=2 and avail_doy between 111 and 121
group by 1 order by 1

SELECT cls, CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS n_trips, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),4) AS yt_per_angler
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2
GROUP BY cls, doy_bucket
ORDER BY cls, doy_bucket
SELECT boat, cls, fish_date_doy, yt, anglers FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy>=95 ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls, boat

SELECT target_date_doy, tide_high_ft, tide_low_ft, tide_high_ft-tide_low_ft AS swing
FROM tides WHERE target_date_season=2 AND target_date_doy BETWEEN 100 AND 121
ORDER BY target_date_doy
SELECT index_id, avail_doy, value FROM climate WHERE avail_season=2 ORDER BY index_id, avail_doy DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT ts_doy, AVG(wtmp_c) AS avg_c FROM pier WHERE ts_season=2 AND ts_doy BETWEEN 108 AND 121 GROUP BY ts_doy ORDER BY ts_doy
